specs.goal: The VM reports the exact ga-sdk SHA it runs whenever that SHA changes, and on request, without a version bump.
specs.why: R0-baseline and later fixes can land without a version change; VMAUTO/VMHUB measurements must cite the SHA the VM ran.
acceptance: after the VM fast-forwards to a new ga-sdk SHA with the same version, one message to baseline-ops names the new full SHA within one update cycle
baseline-ops can ask the VM for its current SHA through the mailbox and gets an answer within one update cycle, with no user action on the VM
the VM runs the R0 test set at R0-baseline and the result (counts, sha, environment) lands in a repository Ops can read
a test proves a same-version SHA change produces exactly one report
constraints: no model call on the VM (ASK-VM-COST pending)
the user's only VM action, if any, is named in a status/1 blocker
